name: CS460 Week 10 — StampLC: SBOM/HBOM + Bus & Firmware Analysis
//image: Prebuilt, multi-arch (linux/amd64 + linux/arm64). Built from .devcontainer/Dockerfile and pushed to GHCR by .github/workflows/devcontainer-image.yml. It bakes the tools, scanners, PlatformIO core, and the QEMU twin, so startup is a pull — not a ~10-minute build; the ESP32-S3 toolchain and Playwright browser are backloaded at runtime by prefetch.sh. node/python/gh are baked in the image, so only docker-in-docker + sshd remain as features.
